text:
Alex: Thinking about a small synth generator for kernel-selection / KV-warmup interplay. Goal: reproduce the perf regression we saw when the kernel chooser mispredicted under bursty long-tail QPS. Proposal: 'entropy-surge sampler' — steady ramp + randomized microbursts seeded from a replay set.

Marta: +1. Can you sketch a config? we need to model KV cold fraction and prefix reuse explicitly.

Jason: Rough idea: 3-phase pattern — warmup steady QPS, ramp to peak, then a long-tail phase with exponential interarrival and correlated key access. Add per-client cache hit-rate param. Keep bursts correlated across clients to exercise batching.

Priya: Include batch-size cap, a max-latency SLO, and simulate kernel switch cost (ms) so we can see switching overheads. Also capture per-token KV lookup distribution and whether hits/misses differ by seqlen.

replay-bot: Quick sim run with the proto config, attaching a small summary. Observed a p99 spike when kernel_switch_cost > 4ms. log snippet:
```
[sim] variant=entropy_surge run=1 p50=12ms p95=86ms p99=432ms kernel_switch_count=120 kv_miss_rate=0.11
```

Alex: Thanks — config sketch below (proto, yaml-like):
```
mode: entropy_surge
clients: 100
base_qps_per_client: 2
ramp_seconds: 30
peak_qps: 800
burst_entropy: 0.18  # 0..1, fraction of requests pulled from randomized microburst generator
kv_cold_fraction: 0.12
kernel_switch_cost_ms: 5
batching.max_tokens: 1024
batching.latency_target_ms: 40
random_seed: 1729
record: [kernel_timeline, batch_composition, per_request_kv_hit]
```

Marta: For apples-to-apples, fix the RNG seed (nice), precompute key distributions from real replay traces, and keep CPU/GPU kernel versions pinned. Record kernel choice timeline and which kernel was active when each request started.

Jason: I'll add a tiny profiler hook to export `kernel_id` per request and `batch_sizes` per step. Note: random microbursts need client correlation to trigger head-of-line batching issues — otherwise they smear out.

Priya: Let's run three variants: baseline (no KV), kv-prefetch (prewarmed population), kv-lazy (on-demand). Run overnight and surface p50/p95/p99, kernel_switch_count, and batch histograms.

Alex: Sounds good. I'll open a replay job and tag it `entropy-test-1716000000`. @Marta please review precomputed key set. @replay-bot please schedule the three variants and push raw traces to s3://redwood-replay/entropy-tests/1716000000 :thumbsup:

Marta: Will review the keyset today. One more ask — include a flag to simulate a mispredicted kernel choice (force_switch=True) so we can measure tail amplification.

Alex: Added to proto. If we see consistent 2x p99 regressions we can iterate on kernel selection heuristics (entropy threshold, history depth).

Jason: I'll prototype a dashboard query to join kernel_timeline with batch_composition so we can eyeball if particular kernels cause larger batches or more switches.

Priya: Great plan. Schedule looks good for tomorrow AM.

replay-bot: Jobs queued: entropy-test-1716000000/{baseline,kv-prefetch,kv-lazy} — will upload traces to s3 when complete.
